# StackCraft Studio

We Build. We Maintain. We Grow.

Freelance web development and website maintenance studio based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.

## Services

- WordPress Website Development (business websites, landing pages, portfolio sites, WordPress customization)
- React Development (responsive, interactive frontend web applications)
- Node.js Development (REST APIs, backend services, database integrations)
- Custom Website Development (tailor-made responsive websites)
- Website Maintenance & Support (bug fixes, security updates, performance optimization, backups, content updates)

## Structure

- Homepage (`/`): Hero, Selected Work, Services, About, Process, FAQ, Reviews, Contact Form & Footer
- Legal pages: `/privacy-policy/`, `/cookies/`
- Sitemap: `/sitemap-index.xml`
